title: Wartime Austin: Rationing, Airport, & Lights
summary:
*   **Supporting the War Effort:** The city approved financial aid for expanded quarters for the Travis County Rationing Board, anticipating federal reimbursement for rent, fuel, and furniture costs.
*   **Airport Infrastructure:** A bid was accepted for nearly $20,000 to construct a new airplane hangar at Robert Mueller Municipal Airport, with additional city funds allocated for the project.
*   **Impact of War on City Officials:** Councilman Oswald G. Wolf was granted a leave of absence to report for duty as a Lieutenant in the U.S. Naval Reserve.
*   **Considering Public Mood for Holidays:** A decision on installing Christmas street lighting was postponed to the next meeting to gauge public sentiment, likely reflecting wartime conservation efforts.

CITY OF AUSTIN: THAT the aforesaid penalty in the sum of $18.46, and one-half of the
interest in the sum of $34.37. are hereby romitted, and the Tax Assessor and Collector of
the City of Austin is authorised and directed to charge said penalty in the sum of $18.46,
and one-half of the interest in the sum of $34.37, off his rolls, and to issue to the
party entitled to receive same a receipt in full upon the payment of said taxes and
one-half of the interest, as aforesaid.
